name: SlateOfficialResult
description: A finalised outcome the world is not allowed to change its mind about: who won an award edition, what a release settled at, what a contract concluded. Written once and never updated, so history cannot be quietly rewritten from the browser.

kind.description: What sort of official result this is.

subject_id.description: The entity inside the save this result belongs to.

decided_at_world.description: The world clock at the moment it was decided.

rules_version.description: Which version of the rules produced it.

seed.description: The deterministic stream that produced the roll.

inputs.description: The inputs and weights the decision was made from.

finalised.description: Always true. A row that exists is final; the backend refuses to change one.
